name: The Gilded Reliquary: the Crypt
about: Asgard's dungeon, rooms G6-G9 (story 7): the Mirror of the Dawn (Veyra), the Rune Bridge, the Waystone Ossuary and the Sunless Crypt (Aurelion, the true Dawn-Flame).

exits.label: back up to the Inquisitors' Chapel

actors.name: Orla
say: This is the guard's ossuary. They sealed the urns. Nobody comes down here.
